CROSS REFERENCE

Game #1
Guesses 0
Hints 0

How to play

Find the secret word. It can be anything from the Bible: a person, place, object, animal, event or idea. You can guess almost any everyday English word too, like person, king or water, to narrow it down.

Every guess gets a rank. The secret word is #1, and the lower the number, the closer you are. Words rank close when they share stories, books, people and themes with the answer.

Very closeGetting thereFar

Stuck? Hint reveals a word closer than your best guess.

Daily gives everyone the same word, with a new one each day. Unlimited gives you a random word whenever you want one.
